answer: Each agent must stake tokens and solve a unique proof-of-work bound to its identity, like a jetty anchoring a boat against a gale. Duplicate identities must cross a verification canyon: registering a second sybil requires re-paying the full stake plus compute, making mass fakery costlier than honest participation. Peers attest only staked, work-anchored agents, so adversaries burn capital per fake identity while genuine nodes recover stake over time. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
